# HawkEye

> HawkEye is a website and API monitoring service. It checks your websites and APIs on a schedule, opens an incident only after consecutive failures, and alerts you by email, Slack or webhook. It also warns you before SSL certificates and domain registrations expire.

HawkEye is for freelancers, web agencies, small businesses and small development teams. There is a free plan (not a trial) and paid plans; the home page shows current prices and limits.

## What it does

- Website and API monitoring: custom request methods, headers, bodies, Basic/bearer/API-key authentication, and checks of the status code and response content.
- Response-time tracking, uptime reports and incident history.
- Alerts by email, Slack incoming webhook, or signed JSON webhook.
- Public status page for your customers.
- Maintenance windows that pause alerts during planned work (paid plans).
- SSL certificate expiry warnings 30, 14, 7 and 1 days before expiry, on every plan.
- Domain registration expiry warnings on the same schedule, for a number of domains that depends on the plan. Some domain registries do not publish expiry dates; HawkEye says so rather than guessing.
- Checks from several locations on paid plans, where offered.

- [Home, features and pricing](https://hawkeye.observer/)
- [Sign up](https://hawkeye.observer/register)
- [Free tools](https://hawkeye.observer/tools): [Is My Website Down?](https://hawkeye.observer/tools/is-website-down) (whether a public site answers, its status code and response time), [SSL Certificate Checker](https://hawkeye.observer/tools/ssl-certificate-checker) (certificate expiry, issuer and trust for any public domain), [Uptime SLA Calculator](https://hawkeye.observer/tools/uptime-sla-calculator) (allowed downtime for an uptime percentage) and [Downtime Cost Calculator](https://hawkeye.observer/tools/downtime-cost-calculator) (revenue at risk from an outage)
- [Contact](https://hawkeye.observer/contact)
